verses.pali: Aṅguttara Nikāya 4.169
verses.english: Numbered Discourses 4.169

verses.pali: 17. Paṭipadāvagga
verses.english: 17. Practice

verses.pali: Sasaṅkhārasutta
verses.english: Extra Effort

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmiṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four individuals are found in the world.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: One individual is fully extinguished in this very life by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: One individual is fully extinguished when the body breaks up by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: One individual is fully extinguished in this very life without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Idha pana, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: One individual is fully extinguished when the body breaks up without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual fully extinguished in this very life by making extra effort?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant meditates observing the ugliness of the body, perceives the repulsiveness of food, perceives dissatisfaction with the whole world, observes the impermanence of all conditions,

verses.pali: Maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṁ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
verses.english: and has well established the perception of their own death.

verses.pali: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati—
verses.english: They rely on these five powers of a trainee:

verses.pali: saddhābalaṁ, hiribalaṁ, ottappabalaṁ, vīriyabalaṁ, paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: And these five faculties manifest in them strongly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ, paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ adhimattattā diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: Because of the strength of the five faculties, they are fully extinguished in this very life by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is fully extinguished in this very life by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
verses.english: How is an individual fully extinguished when the body breaks up by making extra effort?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati, āhāre paṭikūlasaññī, sabbaloke anabhiratisaññī, sabbasaṅkhāresu aniccānupassī.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant meditates observing the ugliness of the body, perceives the repulsiveness of food, perceives dissatisfaction with the whole world, observes the impermanence of all conditions,

verses.pali: Maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṁ sūpaṭṭhitā hoti.
verses.english: and has well established the perception of their own death.

verses.pali: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati—
verses.english: They rely on these five powers of a trainee:

verses.pali: saddhābalaṁ, hiribalaṁ, ottappabalaṁ, vīriyabalaṁ, paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni mudūni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: But these five faculties manifest in them weakly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ, vīriyindriyaṁ, satindriyaṁ, samādhindriyaṁ, paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ muduttā kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: Because of the weakness of the five faculties, they are fully extinguished when the body breaks up by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo kāyassa bhedā sasaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is fully extinguished when the body breaks up by making extra effort.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual fully extinguished in this very life without making extra effort?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant … enters and remains in the first absorption … second absorption … third absorption … fourth absorption …

verses.pali: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati—
verses.english: They rely on these five powers of a trainee:

verses.pali: saddhābalaṁ …pe… paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni adhimattāni pātubhavanti—
verses.english: And these five faculties manifest in them strongly:

verses.pali: saddhindriyaṁ …pe… paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ adhimattattā diṭṭheva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: Because of the strength of the five faculties, they are fully extinguished in this very life without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo diṭṭheva dhamme asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is fully extinguished in this very life without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual fully extinguished when the body breaks up without making extra effort?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… dutiyaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… tatiyaṁ jhānaṁ …pe… catutthaṁ jhānaṁ upasampajja viharati.
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant … enters and remains in the first absorption … second absorption … third absorption … fourth absorption …

verses.pali: So imāni pañca sekhabalāni upanissāya viharati—
verses.english: They rely on these five powers of a trainee:

verses.pali: saddhābalaṁ, hiribalaṁ, ottappabalaṁ, vīriyabalaṁ, paññābalaṁ.
verses.english: faith, conscience, prudence, energy, and wisdom.

verses.pali: Tassimāni pañcindriyāni …pe… paññindriyaṁ.
verses.english: But these five faculties manifest in them weakly: faith, energy, mindfulness, immersion, and wisdom.

verses.pali: So imesaṁ pañcannaṁ indriyānaṁ muduttā kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: Because of the weakness of the five faculties, they are fully extinguished when the body breaks up without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo kāyassa bhedā asaṅkhāraparinibbāyī hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is fully extinguished when the body breaks up without making extra effort.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the four individuals found in the world.”

verses.pali: Navamaṁ.
